concerns: notify_v2 masking now also masks slash/dot-separated dates with 9+ digits in third-party fields (e.g. 'ref 2026/10/07 12:30' -> '[number hidden]:30'); over-masking only, no money impact.
commands: a first line consisting only of a control char (e.g. '\x0b') no longer skips to the next line (returns None); conservative.
Non-ASCII whitespace variants return None rather than invalid (existing-test-driven deviation); fuzzed U+0000-U+2FFF C*/Z* chars: none yields a non-invalid command.
